steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What lies ahead is no place to enter lightly.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder's footprints end here. It seems this is its lair.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is this... another bamboo grove? Hang on, why would bamboo grow underground? Is it connected to the grove above?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: No, this grove is the Lord of Thunder's masterpiece.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Dost thou see the fog wafting through the air? It is the scent of the curse, though not the curse itself.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: There have been sightings of it across the mountains, and no small number have been lost within those vapors.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'Tis proof we are close.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'll go take a look.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How did you get behind me—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Do not act rashly.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: It is the Lord of Thunder nesting here that hath transformed this place.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The bamboo is even thicker than it was ten years ago...

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Slightly hesitant growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The Zinogre is a meownster that likes living near streams. It instinctively made this place into its den.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Ten years ago, the former lord traversed this grove countless times.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's a strange place. Many mewmbers of the expedition teams got lost, and never returned.

a.text: That day, Her Meowjesty entered once more, with us in tow.
At one point, the fog suddenly cleared, along with that eerie aura, and the road ahead appeared before our very whiskers.
I thought it was the Gyorin finally answering my purr-ayers by showing me the way, but when I got to the end of the road, all I saw was—
A bloodthirsty behemoth, and a wisp of black miasma trailing off.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What is it, Madam Catapult?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're glowing.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: She's telling the truth! Mew really are glowing, Your Meowjesty!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This is—
Hofukaru takes a small bottle out of her pocket.
Within it, a flying insect smacks against the glass, it's glowing faintly.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's a Thunderbug!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A Thunderbug?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: A type of insect that lives in purr-fect symbiosis with the Zinogre.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This is the last thing Mother left for me.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: All these years, I have kept this insect by my side. Whenever I look at it, it is as if Mother is still with me.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But it hath always been calm, and barely flickered most times. Why—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I think it wants to get out of there. Why not let it out and see what happens?
Hofukaru nods, opening the bottle. The Thunderbug leisurely flies out, before slowly venturing deep into the grove—

The depths of the sea of bamboo are roused. Many identical lights flicker on one after the other, emerging from the ground, the stalks, the ragged leaves. A forest of stars, flickering on and off, like lanterns swaying in the rainy night.
The shadow looming over the grove is banished by the glimmers. As the wind blows, the shadows of bamboo leaves gently stroke the ground, like drifting green paper cutouts.
Hofukaru stops and raises a finger. A Thunderbug flits past it and spirals upwards, laden with an electric glow brighter than the others.
The specks of light fall from top to bottom, like luminescent rain.
The others stand by her side holding their breaths, as if a single sound would dispel this dreamland of cyan lights.
Within the glittering grove, time is held in the bamboo's grip, leaving behind only a silent pulse.
The Thunderbugs dance, adding a layer of soft, indescribable tranquility to the entire ensemble.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's beautiful.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hah, I'll catch a few to take back home!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is it, Hofukaru?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If they live symbiotically with the Lord of Thunder, they must have come from a faraway land as well. But... why are they not by its side?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: For whatever reason... I cannot help but feel a deep sorrow behind this beauty.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Thunderbugs...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: That's right, Thunderbugs!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mew must've felt it too, Yoshitsune!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Acknowledging growl)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, look!
The disorderly Thunderbugs had converged when the party was not looking, forming a slender ray of light between the bamboo, leading deeper into the fog.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Is this the road you were talking about, Sir Masamune?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-cisely!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Excited growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But it's no road, it's the Thunderbugs lighting the way.

a.text: Lord of Thunder... Were it not for your strength, I would never have... come here!
But it is a pity... It is... too late...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's that voice?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's like... the grove itself is talking to us.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Is that... Mother's voice?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mother! Are you here?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Tell me, what happened to thee?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why doth the Lord of Thunder possess thy power? Did it slay thee?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Calm down, Hofukaru!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: HOFUKARU!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She's gone, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: After her!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We need to find her, quick! These words... If they really are the last words the previous lord managed to leave behind... Hofukaru won't be able to control herself!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is this... a waterfall?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: There are Hexhowl corpses all over the place! They were all slain by Her Meowjesty!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Agitated howl)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There she is!
Hexhowl corpses litter the path ahead. At its end, Hofukaru stands by the waterfall, staring blankly at its base.

a.text: The Lord of Thunder... Its power... is devouring me...
Hofukaru, my beloved daughter... Thou must... become stronger than it... Take back... what is ours by right...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: These words...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: All they're doing is egging her on!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: These Hexhowls sure have great timing!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait for us, Hofukaru—!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have seen where the Lord of Thunder awaits.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, we'll go together—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Once I have slain it, I shall return to thee.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then, thou shalt be able to return home.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did she—Did she just jump down?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We need to fight our way out, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can see that!

a.text: No... Do not make the same mistake I did... Starting the Gyorin... is your only hope... Use the Lord of Thunder's power... and do not... be consumed by hate...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, these words...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are they saying—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Have we been misunderstanding what happened all this time?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What was that, Orchid?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I said we need to get to her ASAP! Before it's too late!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Finally... found thee.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Lord of Thunder...
The Thunderbugs try to approach the Lord of Thunder, but cannot. They are sent flying by the black miasma expelled by its skin.

steps.name: Lord of Thunder
steps.text: (Pained howling)

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I see... So it is the curse that prevents the Thunderbugs from approaching thee. No wonder they seem so sorrowful.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Does living in a land that is not thine own also bring thee great suffering?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then allow me to end thy pain.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Finally broke through—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Over there! That altar in the ruins! Hofukaru's fighting the Lord of Thunder!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hiiiyaaaaah—!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou art strong indeed.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: In that case—
The miko's power flares up, its light wrapping around her in an instant and rapidly enveloping the Lord of Thunder as well.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Gah—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Of course. 'Twould not be so simple.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: However, I have long since steeled mine heart.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If I cannot take back my mother's power, then at least I can...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why's all that light coming out of her? Is she using her power to absorb the Lord of Thunder's curse?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: N-No! That's not what absorbing the curse looks like!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: She's... She's making her own miko power resonate with the power of the purr-evious lord within the Zinogre!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Resonate? Do you mean—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She intends to sacrifice herself to take down the beast!?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Anxious growl)

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: This is bad! All that power is drawing the Hexhowls that fell from the sinkhole, and the curse-infected beasts, straight to the altar!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Her Meowjesty is going to be swallowed up by the tide!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Then we'll have to stop it first.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But how?! We're too far from the altar! Not even Wirebugs can reach her in time!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult and Masamune, you ride Yoshitsune and cut off the beasts beneath the altar. Help me buy some time!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mya?! But—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No time to explain, just trust me!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's go, you two!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why do I always find myself cleaning up their messes?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: From this position... and this angle... it should still make it in time.
The moment they first saw this cavern, Orchid had realized a way of resolving this.
She raises her bow, aiming at a distant rock wall. A large, jagged boulder hangs there, right above the path the horde must follow.
Knocking it down would be no simple task, but she noticed an instability in the rocky strata. A single shot with enough power and accuracy should do the trick.
She can do it.
Even she is surprised by this confidence. Shocked, even. It's the exact same disbelief she felt when she actually stepped up to admonish Hofukaru and the samurai.
Her old self would never... right?
She draws her bow, storing up power.
Countless thoughts flow through her mind, but the chaotic mess does not bother her. On the contrary, she has never felt herself more focused than she is now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: At first, I thought their Houei versions were better than the originals.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: An independent Popukar,

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: an enthusiastic Spot,

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: and a rational and restrained Midnight.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I was wrong.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: They have their own issues too, and deep down, they're the same as the ones we know.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If Popukar hadn't been brought to Rhodes Island by Dr. Kal'tsit. If Spot and Midnight had never joined because of their Oripathy.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If they hadn't joined A6... No, if we hadn't formed A6.

spans.text: If they hadn't joined A6... No, if

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Their personalities may not be the same as their Houei counterparts, but they all have the strength to stand on their own two feet.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But conversely, when push comes to shove, they only know how to rely on themselves.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: When there's only one choice, it's no choice at all.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I always remind myself... I still need to respect them for who they are.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So I'm happy to give advice, but I never stop them. I just lend them a hand whenever they fall. I consider that a form of respect.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What I wrote to Midnight was really meant for myself.
What can I do for those I care for?
She releases her bowstring.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What's going on with Orchid? She's been acting purr-etty strangely ever since we came underground!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She's... confused.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She's always acting like it's none of her business, but she really does care for the people around her.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Too much even, to the point where she doesn't know how to express it. Until finally, she chose to act like she didn't care.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Over time, she even managed to fool herself.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She cares about our team, obviously, but...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Since she stepped up to take charge earlier, I'm sure she'll find a way out now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'll let you in on a little secret, Masamune.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We've never told her this, but whenever we A6ers are in a pinch, one phrase always comes to mind—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid always has a plan.
With a screech, an arrow zooms over the horde and past the shadowy underground ruins, like a meteor streaking across the sky.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: A Dragon Piercer?!
The 'meteor' smashes into the top of the rock wall, triggering a violent rumbling.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's collapsing!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha! That's our Orchid!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The beasts are blocked off! Orchid is calling us over to get to Hofukaru, so let's move!
